snippet.title: WarSpawn Devlog 5: Demo Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
I am excited to announce that the public WarSpawn demo will be available on Steam May 9th! I hope you all enjoy this demo announcement trailer, and don't forget to give the game a wishlist on Steam (check the links below).

🔻 What is WarSpawn?🔻  

WarSpawn blends soulslike combat with Rakion Online-style PvP, all drenched in Lovecraftian and Moebius vibes. A PvE Solo Survival mode has also recently been added, providing a PvP alternative or just a change of pace for players!

👉 Subscribe for more devlogs & demo updates: https://www.youtube.com/@sloth_boss
👉 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2689920/WarSpawn/
👉 Follow on X: https://x.com/SlothyLabs
